examined_formations.title: LOGISTICS_MULTI_SYSTEM_AR_AP_RECONCILIATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 物流多系统应收应付对账桥
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Logistics firms still export WMS/TMS/ERP/Excel data and manually reconcile complex contract rates, but current Kingdee and BMS/TMS products already ingest multi-source data, normalize documents, compare rules, flag differences and generate settlement/accounting outputs.

examined_formations.title: MANUFACTURING_BOM_REPORT_AND_ORDER_COPY_BRIDGE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 制造业BOM报表订单跨系统搬运桥
examined_formations.evidence_summary: ERP/MES/PLM/WMS/OA/Excel copy-paste remains common, but current RPA/IDP/agent and low-code offerings explicitly automate BOM import/version comparison, inventory triggers, order invoicing, report aggregation and cross-system writeback.

examined_formations.title: CROSS_BORDER_DECLARATION_DATA_REENTRY_BRIDGE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 跨境报关数据重复录入桥
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Cross-border declaration platforms already support ERP/platform API integration, Excel template imports, document generation and one-click declarations; the manual bridge is generic integration rather than a distinct operator asset.

examined_formations.title: CHAIN_STORE_OMNICHANNEL_SETTLEMENT_RECONCILIATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 连锁门店全渠道清分对账桥
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current chain-store platforms already aggregate Meituan, Taobao instant retail, Douyin, WeChat and other receipts, reconcile order-to-settlement differences and automate split settlement.

examined_formations.title: SMALL_LOGISTICS_WECHAT_EXCEL_TO_TMS_BRIDGE
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current small-logistics TMS products directly advertise multi-channel order entry, WeChat/Excel import, dispatch, automated billing/reconciliation and management reporting.
